_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-2 inputs. Read by F16GeomL2 (.geometry) and F16AeroL2 (.aerodynamics). Geometry = Brandt-F16-A.xls Main-tab spec; aerodynamics = genuine aero spec (ALL geometry injected from the geom object, none stored here).

geometry._src: Brandt-F16-A.xls Main tab (wing B18:B22, pitch_ctrl C18:C22, vert_tail H18:H22, fuselage B32/C32/D32). CITATION CORRECTION 2026-07-25 (repo-wide; examples/F16A/F16GeomL3.md §F is authoritative): Main row 20 = 'Taper Ratio', row 21 = 'Sweep, deg', row 22 = 'NACA 4-digit' -- so taper is {B,C,H}20 (was cited 21), LE sweep is {B,C,H}21 (was cited 20), and t/c comes from the row-22 NACA 4-digit designation (B22=1404, C22=H22='0004'; last two digits = thickness in % chord -> 0.04) rather than row 24, which is 'Y Location' with B24/C24 EMPTY. The former 'B18:B24' ranges were therefore too wide and row 24 is not an input source. ZERO computed values change -- only the audit trail moves. HT/VT tc_root/tc_tip = T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I biconvex splits, and are now the SINGLE t/c basis: the uniform HT/VT tc_ratio inputs were REMOVED (locked decision 6), and where a uniform value is needed (the Brandt Geom!B13 uniform-t/c S_wet alternate) it is the derived root/tip mean, 0.0475 HT / 0.0415 VT. The wing KEEPS tc_ratio=0.04 [Main!B22, NACA 4-digit 1404; corroborated T.O. 1F-16A-1 Fig. 1-2 NACA 64A204]: it is genuinely uniform-t/c with no root/tip split available, and tc_r_wing/tc_t_wing mirror it as Dependent. Engine SLS thrust is NO LONGER a geometry input: T_AB_SLS_lb was REMOVED and is now DERIVED from the injected propulsion object's T_SL (dependency injection) = .propulsion.T_SL = 23770 lbf [Brandt Engn(s)!T_AB_SLS = Main!D29], so nacelle diameter D_inlet=sqrt(T/1900) and the 155.57 ft2 of duct wetted area track a thrust change instead of staying pinned to a stale copy; duct_length_ft stays a genuine airframe input. MINIMUM input set: derived quantities (spans, chords, MACs, sweep conversions, exposed/wetted areas, D_fus, Amax, D_inlet/D_exit) are Dependent getters and are deliberately absent.
geometry._overall_length_ft_src: L_aircraft, whole-aircraft length, ft -- feeds ONLY the Raymer 6th ed. Eq. 12.44 Sears-Haack wave-drag term as (Amax/l)^2. Published F-16A airframe length, 47 ft 7.75 in = 47.6458 ft (47.65 is a +0.009% rounding). PROVENANCE CAVEAT, stated plainly: this figure is NOT traceable to any document in this repo -- neither '47.65', '47 ft 7.75 in', nor any overall-length figure appears anywhere in air_vehicle_design/sizing/ (grepped 2026-07-25). The VALUE stands as the user's decision (2026-07-25); pinning it to a primary source is a standing OPEN item, VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md 2026-07-25 Phase 2 §6. Not derivable in-model: the geometry object has no nose-boom / tailcone x-stations. DISTINCT from fuselage.length_ft = 46.5 at L2. Brandt Geom!B21 = 48.303947 is a MAX() over his component x-station columns -- an EXTENT of his own layout, not a published spec dimension -- so the two are NOT the same quantity: 48.303947 is a comparison reference only (report row annotated 'definitional'), never an input.
geometry._TODO_overall_length_ft: VALUE APPROVED, CITATION NOT PINNED. overall_length_ft=47.65 is the published F-16A airframe length (47 ft 7.75 in = 47.6458 ft) supplied from general knowledge -- it is NOT traceable to any document in this repo (grepped 2026-07-25: no overall-length figure appears anywhere in air_vehicle_design/sizing/). The value stands as the user's decision (2026-07-25); only its provenance is open. Remove this key when the figure is pinned to T.O. 1F-16A-1 or another named primary source. Brandt Geom!B21 = 48.303947 does NOT pin it: that cell is a MAX() over his component x-station columns (an extent of his own layout), not a published spec dimension, so it is a different quantity. Standing item: VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md 2026-07-25 Phase 2 §6.

aerodynamics._src: Cfe = Raymer 6th Table 12.3 (AF fighter, 0.0035) for Eq. 12.23 CD0. e_method='official' = Raymer Eq. 12.48/12.49. airfoil = NACA 64A204 (T.O. 1F-16A-1 Fig. 1-2).

airfoil.name: NACA 64A204
airfoil._TODO_alpha_L0_deg: alpha_L0=-1.01 unverified vs a primary NACA 64A204 source (thin-airfoil ~ -1.4 to -1.9); remove this key when pinned. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_AlphaL0Unverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_max_2D: cl_max_2D=1.20 (Abbott & von Doenhoff) conflicts with NTRS-19870017427's 1.0; remove when reconciled. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClMax2DUnverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_alpha_per_deg: cl_alpha=0.105/deg is an internet-band midpoint, not primary-sourced; remove when pinned. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClAlpha2DUnverified.

propulsion._src: Brandt-F16-A.xls Engn(s) tab (T_AB_SLS, T_mil_SLS), Main!C29 (dry/mil), Main!D29 (AB), Miss!C25 = Main!C25 (install factor); T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I; Mattingly AED 2nd ed. (TSFC Eq. 3.55a/b, T_t4 Table C.4). Per examples/F16A/F16PropL2.md + docs/propulsion_parameter_usage.md Part A/B, these are the engine-spec inputs F16PropL2 reads; all lapse/TSFC/TR OUTPUTS are DERIVED and are not stored here.
propulsion._thrust_source: SLS thrusts, lbf. T_SL / T_SL_wet = AB (max) = Brandt Engn!T_AB_SLS = Main!D29 = 23770; T_SL_mil = military (dry) = Brandt Engn!T_mil_SLS = Main!C29 = 15000; T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I.
propulsion._C_note: The Mattingly TSFC coefficients (C1_mil/C2_mil/C1_AB/C2_AB = 0.90/0.30/1.60/0.27, Eq. 3.55a/b) are NOT stored here. Per user decision 2026-07-24 they are engine-class Constants selected by engine_type inside the PropL2 toolbox (mirroring PropL1's engine_type-keyed lapse/TSFC tables) -- this JSON supplies only engine_type, which selects the coefficient set. Verified-agreement provenance in todo.md 2026-07-24 entry 5.
propulsion._T_t4_max_source: Burner-exit total temperature, deg F. Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Table C.4 (F100-PW-100).
propulsion._T_t4_max_note: Feeds the throttle-ratio input (TR = T_t4_max / T_t4_SLS, Mattingly Eq. D.6). T_t4_SLS is unknown, so the DERIVED TR defaults to 1.0 (independently corroborated by Brandt Engn(s)!S1). TR is derived and is NOT stored in this input block.
propulsion._TSFC_install_factor_source: Brandt Miss!C25 = Main!C25 (readme_mission.md Engine Model; also stored in GroundTruth/f16a_geometry.json engine.TSFC_install_factor).
propulsion._TSFC_install_factor_note: The framework wires installed = uninstalled x 1.08 onto the Mattingly (uninstalled) TSFC. The stored Brandt SLS TSFCs 0.70 (mil) / 2.20 (AB) are ALREADY installed (they include the 1.08 factor) -- do not double-apply (todo.md 2026-07-24 entry 4).
propulsion._engine_type_note: Engine-class identifier (F100-PW-200 class). Selects the Mattingly TSFC coefficient set (C1/C2 mil+AB, Eq. 3.55a/b) from the PropL2 toolbox's engine_type-keyed table (user decision 2026-07-24, decision b). The thrust lapse (Mattingly Eq. 2.54a/b) uses the analytical model directly.
propulsion._engine_model_note: Descriptor: F-16A Block 10/15 powerplant (F100-PW-200 class), per examples/F16A/F16PropL1.md. Recorded for provenance; not read numerically. Note T_t4_max_F traces to Mattingly Table C.4's F100-PW-100 entry, the closest tabulated variant.

weights._comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-2 weight-estimation inputs (Raymer 6th ed. Table 15.2 surface-density structural groups + AE481 metabook §7 engine/all-else fractions). Read by F16WeightsL2. Only genuine engine spec + config stored here; the Table-15.2 psf densities and AE481 fractions are category-selected Constants inside the WeightsL2 toolbox (NOT JSON inputs; see _formula_constants_note). Exposed areas + fuselage wetted area are injected LIVE from an F16GeomL2 object (see _geometry_via_DI).
weights._geometry_via_DI: Injected LIVE from an F16GeomL2 object in Step 2c, NOT stored here: S_w (= geom S_exposed_wing = 196.23), S_ht (= geom S_exposed_ht = 49.85), S_vt (= geom S_exposed_vt = 40.89) -- exposed areas match geom exactly; and S_wet_fus (= geom get_S_wet_fuselage). NB value divergence for 2c to reconcile: weights S_wet_fus=750 (unpinned estimate) vs geom fuselage wetted 730.30 ft2.
weights._formula_constants_note: The Raymer Table 15.2 psf densities (wing 9.0 / HT 4.0 / VT 5.3 / fuselage 4.8 lbf/ft2) and the AE481 §7 fractions (landing gear 0.033, all-else-empty 0.17, installed-engine 1.3) are NOT JSON inputs -- they are Constants selected by aircraft_category inside the WeightsL2 toolbox (mirroring the propulsion lookup_TSFC_coeffs precedent). NB LG 0.033 (framework) vs 0.034 (Brandt/subplan) -- todo.md 2026-07-24 §3c item 2.
weights._aircraft_category_source: Selects the Raymer Table 15.2 fighter psf row + AE481 §7 fighter fractions. Matches F16WeightsL2 default.
weights._W_en_source: Bare/dry engine weight, lbf. [estimate; verify TO 1F-16A-1 or Jane's All the World's Aircraft -- NOT pinned]. Feeds the AE481 §7 installed-engine = 1.3*N_en*W_en fraction.
weights._W_payload_fixed_source: Fixed equipment + crew, lbf. [estimate: 1 pilot + survival gear -- NOT pinned to a repo source].
weights._W_payload_expendable_source: Expendable payload, lbf; set by mission profile. [WeightsBase contract].
